children.value: > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.

> > > Fact From Story: FTX’s collapse Concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity grew after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet, showing the firm held $14.6 billion in assets and $8 billion in liabilities as of June 30, 2022.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A company that has more liabilities than assets is at risk of collapse.
> Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start”.

> > > Fact From Story: FTX’s collapse Concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity grew after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet, showing the firm held $14.6 billion in assets and $8 billion in liabilities as of June 30, 2022.
> > > Fact From Story: The Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Fraud involves misappropriation of funds.
> > Fact From Story: The Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”

> > > Fact From Story: FTX’s collapse Concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity grew after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet, showing the firm held $14.6 billion in assets and $8 billion in liabilities as of June 30, 2022.
> > > Fact From Story: SBF co-founded FTX in 2019.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO is responsible for the actions of their company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Illegal activity can lead to wire fraud and conspiracy charges.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud and conspiracy are crimes.
